div.div:
Phase 1 baseline (repro/ + AgentBench, this repo's earlier track)
ReAct + llama.cpp 8B Q4 + Cohere FAISS dense + cross-encoder rerank
retrieval-time fraction bracket: 11% (dense) → 31% (+rerank) → 45% (live Wikipedia API)
This HDD/DiskANN track replaces the search backend to make that fraction a controllable variable (storage medium) instead of a network artifact.

text.tspan: Phase 1 baseline (repro/ + AgentBench, this repo's earlier track)
ReAct + llama.cpp 8B Q4 + Cohere FAISS dense + cross-encoder rerank
This HDD/DiskANN track replaces the search backend to make that fraction a
controllable variable (storage medium) instead of a network artifact.

div.div:
Qdrant + HNSW — REJECTED
47M vectors ingested OK (209 GB, 13h)
cold search: NOT complete after 48 min
cause: visits ~O(segments × ef × hop) nodes,
reads full vector per node — HDD random
4KB access can't keep up (68 IOPS measured)

text.tspan: cold search: NOT complete after 48 min
reads full vector per node — HDD random
4KB access can't keep up (68 IOPS measured)

div.div:
Milvus + DiskANN — ADOPTED
1M vectors measured: 25 GB footprint
cold search: 17.7 s (collection load: 25.5 min)
cause: PQ-compressed vectors held in RAM,
search cost is O(search_list), ~independent
of corpus size — fits an HDD's IOPS budget

text.tspan: cause: PQ-compressed vectors held in RAM,
of corpus size — fits an HDD's IOPS budget
